svg.title: How LLM Peer Review runs, as one line
svg.desc: The line runs top to bottom. Gate in is the session-start hook. Then explore, create-plan with a critic loop of up to 2 rounds, your approval, execute with a check loop on every step, review with an audit and fix loop of up to 2 tries, and document. Merge lands worktree PRs when you start it. Gate out sits under document and merge: it is the pre-push check, run before every push Claude makes. A dotted branch line from create-plan leads to the GPT or Gemini debate, which runs only when you ask.
